thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-9823 triggered — p99 latency SLO breach detected for /generate (global). Current p99 ~ 620ms, p95 ~ 210ms. Auto-page to #eng-oncall fired.

pagerduty-bot: PD-9823 assigned to sam (ack required) :rotating_light:

sam: ack. I'm on it. grabbing metrics and recent deploys.

miguel: i can look at routing/sidecars in eu-west. saw a couple of sidecar restarts earlier.

anya: FYI I pushed a small sidecar change yesterday that adjusted batching behavior but it was behind a feature flag. not sure if related.

sam: checking top-level dashboards — requests/sec steady, but tail latency spike aligns with a rise in queued tokens on sidecar queues. running PromQL: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket[1m])) by (le))` now.

sam: also seeing KV cache evictions metric increase ~ 00:36 UTC. key_evictions_total spiked. suspect cache thrash causing regen work and slowing p99.

miguel: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep sidecar` — several sidecars show `RESTARTS>3` in eu-west-1. grabbing logs.

sam: logs show OOMKilled on sidecar-7 container around the spike. stacktrace points to sustained mem growth during large batch decode.

anya: that feature-flagged batch change can increase in-flight buffer sizes when enabled. can you confirm if the flag was on for eu-west clusters?

sam: checking config map... `kubectl get cm inference-flags -n infra -o yaml` -> the flag `opt.experimental_batch_expand=true` is set in eu-west.

mike (ops-lead): if the flag increases memory, we should roll it back fast to stop OOMs and reduce tail. recommended plan: 1) disable flag in eu-west CM, 2) scale sidecar deployment to 0/ then back to desired to force fresh containers, 3) enable autoscaler fallback to reserve capacity.

sam: agree. preparing rollback. patching CM now: `kubectl patch cm inference-flags -n infra -p '{"data":{"opt.experimental_batch_expand":"false"}}'`

sam: patch applied. initiating rollout restart: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/sidecar-proxy -n inference --selector=region=eu-west`

pagerduty-bot: PD-9823 acknowledged by sam. escalation timer paused.

miguel: restarting sidecars... watch on logs.

anya: i've also flagged a temporary increase in sidecar memory limits to 1.5x as short-term mitigation, but prefer the flag rollback first.

sam: after restart, initial telemetry shows p99 dropped from 620ms -> 240ms over 90s. KV evictions trending down.

sam: patching autoscaler policy to add a small buffer for sidecars in eu-west to avoid immediate scale-in. `kubectl apply -f hpa-sidecar-buffer.yaml`

mike (ops-lead): good. Sam can you open an incident ticket with timeline, root-cause hypothesis (feature flag + memory regression -> OOM -> tail p99), and customer impact estimate? Mark severity P2.

sam: creating incident doc now (INC-2023). adding graphs, logs, and steps taken. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2023

anya: follow-up actions: run ASAN/mem-profiling on the sidecar change, add feature-flag rollout guard (circuit-breaker if mem rises), and add an alert for key_evictions_total spike.

miguel: i'll own the postmortem section on detection + runbook changes. sam can own recovery timeline and customer comms. anya will own the code fix/tests.

mike (ops-lead): handoff to next oncall in 40m. set PD to quiet for now but leave the incident open until we've confirmed stable p99 < 250ms for 30m.

sam: noted. current p99 ~ 210ms, p95 ~ 120ms. leaving monitoring configured for 30m clean window.

incident-bot: Incident PD-9823 status -> acknowledged by sam. tags: p99-latency, kv-evictions, sidecar-oom, rollback-applied.

ops-lead: customer impact: internal metrics show no user-facing 5xx spike, but interactive experiences may have had degraded latency for <10% of requests during 00:36-00:41 UTC. recommended outreach to top-10 customers if postmortem confirms customer-visible degradation.

sam: adding a short incident summary in the channel and will update INC-2023 every 15m until stable.

anya: one more note — adding a canary gate for future batch-expand rollouts and a limit to the memory growth.

sam: handing off to miguel for overnight watch. I'm logging off in ~30m; miguel, ping me if p99 climbs back above 400ms.

miguel: acked. I'll watch and escalate to ops-lead if we see >2x increase.

ops-lead: thanks everyone. closing PD page for now but keeping incident open. :white_check_mark:
